meta_title: ST Plumbing & Heating | Emergency Plumber Guildford
meta_description: ST Plumbing & Heating Guildford. Emergency plumbing, boiler repairs, and heating installations. Fast response, Gas Safe registered. Call now for same-day help.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe at 2am? Our engineers reach most Guildford homes in under an hour, any day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Guildford
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to new boiler installations, we handle every plumbing job with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry common parts on the van and aim to solve most issues the same day, 24/7.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Repair
services.desc: New Gas Safe–approved boiler installs with 10-year warranties. Repairs and servicing to keep your heating running safely through winter.

services.title: Central Heating Setup
services.desc: Complete heating system design and installation. We'll upgrade your radiators, pipework, and controls to improve efficiency and comfort.

services.title: Radiator & Valve Work
services.desc: Radiator fitting, removal, and balancing. Thermostatic valve upgrades cut your bills and give you room-by-room temperature control.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Supply and fit taps, toilets, showers, and waste pipes. We handle full refurb plumbing so your new suite works perfectly from day one.

services.title: Landlord & Maintenance Contracts
services.desc: Regular servicing, safety certificates, and priority callout for multiple properties. Designed to keep your rental portfolio running smoothly.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was fed up seeing cowboys charge my mates ridiculous money.
about_para_1: ST Plumbing & Heating was founded 18 years ago on a simple principle: turn up on time, do the job properly, and charge a fair price. What began as one van and one engineer has grown into a trusted local team serving Guildford and surrounding areas. Every engineer carries Gas Safe certification and the tools to fix most jobs immediately.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation by treating every home like it's our own. Customers call us back because we listen to what you need, explain the options without jargon, and stick to our quotes. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned boiler swap, you'll get the same straight-talking service.
reviews_heading: What Guildford Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Pipe burst at midnight on a Sunday. Rang ST Plumbing expecting to pay a fortune for emergency cover—Mark turned up in 45 minutes, fixed it properly, and charged me the same rate as a weekday. Honest work. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had the old boiler replaced last month. Engineer was polite, explained everything clearly, and the paperwork was sorted right away. Quoted £4,200, came in at £4,200. No surprise costs. System works a treat and feels so much warmer already.
reviews.author: Linda M.

reviews.text: They fitted new rads and a thermostat in my upstairs. Neat work, no mess left behind. They even showed me how to balance the system so I'm not heating empty rooms. Bill was fair. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: James T.
